documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

Board Meeting Intimation for Intimation Of Board Meeting For Approval Of Un-Audited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter And Half Year Ended On September 30, 2026.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Mayur Uniquoters reported Q1 FY27 standalone revenue of INR 247.03 crores and consolidated revenue of INR 269.23 crores, driven by higher exports and product mix changes. Management noted that growth momentum from U.S. OEM supply orders is expected to continue over the next two to three years. The company is expanding production capacity in its current premises by adding a new line expected to start production by February or March 2027, while international and greenfield expansions remain under evaluation due to market volatility. Management also highlighted that raw material prices and increased freight costs impacted margins during the quarter.

guidance.claim: The company expects domestic growth between 8% to 10% and export growth between 15% to 20%.
guidance.quote: our expectation from domestic growth is between 8%-10%. And our expectation from export growth is from 15%-20%.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the value growth will be much more than the volume growth.
guidance.quote: obviously, the value growth will be much more than the volume growth because our export prices are much more higher.

guidance.claim: The company targets a 15% value growth outlook for the coming year.
guidance.quote: So we have kept potential outlook for 15% growth in the coming year also.

guidance.claim: Management stated that value growth is expected to be 15% on average for the next 2 years.
Management expects margins to remain at similar levels and go slightly better.
guidance.quote: Definitely, it will remain in the similar levels where we are right now, and it can go slightly better also.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the domestic footwear market experienced a degrowth and muted market conditions during the quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: I think so we have -- if you compare Y-o-Y from last quarter to this year's quarter, I think so we have grown on the domestic front also. And there's a degrowth in the export OEM market because the business -- the shipments will start going more from this quarter onwards.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the PU business remains muted at present with sales not increasing significantly.
demand_outlook.quote: So, PU, still the business is muted right now. We have not been able to succeed too much in terms of the volume in PU and increasing in sales.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that Q4 is generally the best quarter for the company.
demand_outlook.quote: Always Q4 is the best. Generally, if you see the trend, then Q4 is generally better.

demand_outlook.claim: European automotive industry is experiencing degrowth.
demand_outlook.quote: But if you see, European automotive industry is not growing as much rather than it's -- there is a story of degrowth over there.

demand_outlook.claim: Footwear business growth is impacted by local competition and low price margins.
demand_outlook.quote: Our Footwear business is not growing because of local competition, because of price -- low price margin.

demand_outlook.claim: Plasticizer and yarn prices have started going up.
demand_outlook.quote: In fact, plasticizers prices have started going up. Yarn prices have started going up.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has ordered a new line for expansion in its current premises to start production by February or March 2027 with an additional capacity of 5 lakh meters.
capex_expansion.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027. So we'll have an additional production capacity of 5 lakh meters.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the planned capex for financial year 2026-2027 is around INR 50 crores.
The company has ordered a new coating line to be installed within an existing facility.
capex_expansion.quote: In India, we have ordered a coating line. But instead of putting it in South India, we have found space in an existing facility only.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure for a global location is estimated around INR 300 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: But the CAPEX would be around INR 300 Cr for a global location.

capex_expansion.claim: The new coating line ordered for the existing location should be completed by the end of the calendar year.
capex_expansion.quote: We have already ordered for an existing location. So, by the end of this calendar year, it should be done.

capex_expansion.claim: A capex on a global scale would be INR300 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: If we do on a global scale, it will be INR300 crores over there.

capex_expansion.claim: The South plant will start with 500,000 millimeters per month initially.
capex_expansion.quote: And we will start with 500,000 millimetres per month initially.

capex_expansion.claim: The planned expansion right now is about the PVC plant.
capex_expansion.quote: Whatever you're talking about expansion right now is about the PVC plant.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that shipment costs for exports increased 4x higher during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: It's 4x higher, the shipment cost was increased.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that sustainable margins are expected to be around 25% plus 1% or 2%.
margins_costs.quote: No. This margin is -- actually, we told you earlier also in our previous con call that margin -- sustainable margin will be 25 plus 1% or 2%.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices for paste PVC went up significantly as a petroleum by-product.
margins_costs.quote: So, obviously, it's a petroleum by-product. So, the prices have gone up and the prices have gone up significantly.

margins_costs.claim: Other expenses decreased in the quarter due to lower freight costs and controlled maintenance expenses.
margins_costs.quote: Our freight cost has gone down in this quarter because of this war situation and all and second one our maintenance cost repair and maintenance cost and consumables were also controlled and because of these two reasons our other income reduced

margins_costs.claim: Operating efficiency improved in the last quarter compared to the previous year, contributing to better margins.
margins_costs.quote: our productivity where we measure the OE has also improved in the last quarter compared to our previous year and that has also contributed to the improvement in margins.

margins_costs.claim: Standalone revenue increased by 22% and PBT and PAT increased by 71% and 77% on a Y-o-Y basis.
margins_costs.quote: In the quarter, the stand-alone revenue increased by 22% and PBT and PAT both increased by 71% and 77% on Y-o-Y basis.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue increased by 14% and PBT and PAT increased by 58% and 66%.
margins_costs.quote: In this quarter, the consolidated revenue increased by 14% and PBT and PAT increased by 58% and 66%.

margins_costs.claim: Imported raw materials account for nearly one-third of total raw material cost.
margins_costs.quote: Normally, imports are nearly 1/3 of our total raw material cost.

margins_costs.claim: Other income for the quarter includes around 50% from foreign exchange gain.
margins_costs.quote: This quarter, other income has the major part of foreign exchange gain around 50% and remaining is our treasury income.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that capacity utilization is currently between 75% and 78%.
orders_capacity.quote: So, we are utilizing somewhere between 75% to 78%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company registered a total volume of 31 million meters.
Total volume growth for the year was approximately 5%.
orders_capacity.quote: Volume growth is a total 4.5%. Nearly 5%.

orders_capacity.claim: The new coating line is expected to increase average monthly capacity by approximately 5 lakh meters.
orders_capacity.quote: Generally average is 5 lakh meter monthly. It is rough calculation, it could be 4 and 6 too, but average will be that.

orders_capacity.claim: Total volume for the quarter was 76.3 lakh meters, including PU of 2.56 lakh meters.
orders_capacity.quote: Total volume has been 76.3 lakh meters, including PU, which has been 2.56 lakh meters for the quarter and value 6.17.

risks_headwinds.claim: Initially in March, there was a challenge regarding expectations of raw material availability issues.
risks_headwinds.quote: So, there was a challenge initially in the month of March where people were expecting that there could be an issue regarding the availability of the raw material.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the world is moving towards deglobalization.
risks_headwinds.quote: But world is moving towards deglobalization also.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the sales growth and increased momentum from U.S. OEM supply orders to continue in the next 2 to 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this sales growth and increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the additional production line in current premises to start production by February or March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects export momentum and value growth to continue over the next 2-3 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2-3 years.

management_commitments.claim: The increased export momentum is expected to continue in the next 2 to 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: The company has a plan to carry out plantation at a large scale in coming years.
management_commitments.quote: Under the Corporate Social Responsibility programs, we have contributed towards the regular plantation, around 45,000 and more plants already we have planted and have a plan to do it at large scale in coming years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
